## Research Path

Tank tracks small is a [researchable](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Research) item which unlocks the following components:

| Category | Component |
| --- | --- |
| [Vehicle Control](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Vehicle_Control) | Tank Wheel (Small) |
| [Vehicle Control](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Vehicle_Control) | Tank Drive Wheel (Small) |
